entries.title: New project
entries.text: Starts a new project with no builds, notes, to-dos or plans. Give it a name; it becomes the active project unless you turn that off.

entries.title: Switch to it right away
entries.text: On: the new project becomes the active one for every device and session as soon as it is created.

entries.title: Switch or manage projects
entries.text: Opens the project list: switch, start a new one, rename, archive or delete (archive and delete ask you to type the project id; the data stays on disk).

entries.title: Project on the banner
entries.text: Shows the active project as a chip on the banner. Tap the chip to switch.

entries.title: Projects
entries.text: Settings for the project switcher: the banner chip, reloading after a switch, and the CLI and API to do the same without the console.

entries.title: New project
entries.text: Opens the form for a new, empty project.

entries.title: Duplicate
entries.text: Makes a new project from this one: its settings, build rules, skin, Claude accounts, plugin setup, manifest, rules and instructions. Lists, to-dos, notes and plans come as structure only unless you pick everything. Its builds stay with the original.

entries.title: Save as boilerplate
entries.text: Keeps this project as a named boilerplate every project can start from (shared on the hub). Pick what its lists, notes and plans carry.

entries.title: Lists, to-dos, notes and plans
entries.text: Structure only (the default): the lists, note folders and plan categories, no items. Everything: with their items. Leave them out: none of it.

entries.title: Bring the builds history
entries.text: Adds a read-only list of the project's past builds to the copy. Off by default; the builds themselves always stay with the original.

entries.title: Boilerplates
entries.text: Saved boilerplates: start a new project from one, rename it, update it from a project, or delete it (type its id; Brett can veto a delete).

entries.title: New project from it
entries.text: Starts a new project from this boilerplate and switches to it. For a new repo too, use the New project wizard's Start from.

entries.title: Duplicate project
entries.text: Opens the duplicate form for the active project (voice: 'duplicate this project').
